changelog: Security: analytics and invitations are read per tenant with `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION` off (leak audit WP3 + WP5, the #2542 pattern). Before, `withTenantScope()` was the only filter and it is a passthrough with the flag off, so every `groupBy`/`count` in `/api/admin/analytics` (funnel, mentor workload, interactions, meetings, RSVP, projects, trends, signup door), `aging`, `funnel`, `cohorts`, `deal-value`, `match-quality` and `/api/cohorts` summed every organization, and a MARKETING admin read the INTERNSHIP product's numbers and candidate names. Each route now ANDs `tenantWhere(session)` in by hand; interactions and meetings are attributed through their relation (or project) via `src/lib/analyticsScope.ts` (pure, unit-tested). `analytics/benchmark`'s peer pool is the caller's own world (`worldOfOrg`), and a NULL-org row folds into the default org. The internship-only reports are gated server-side with `requireCapability(…, 'mentorship')`: `/api/cohorts` (GET/POST), `analytics/cohorts` and `analytics/match-quality` answer `403 capability_unavailable`. `analytics/aging` keeps its stage-level numbers for every vertical (#2423) but withholds the per-candidate lists (`oldestStuck`/`overdue`, `candidateLists: false`), and the page hides that panel and the cohort card. `POST /api/cohorts` now stamps `orgId` (a NULL cohort was the default org's). The premium tier in `cohorts`/`sources`/`benchmark` is read for the caller's org explicitly. `GET /api/invite` lists only the caller's org. `/api/invite/[id]` resend/extend/delete look the row up inside the tenant and answer 404 for a foreign or missing id; DELETE of a missing id used to answer 200. `/api/admin/invitations` and `/bulk` move from `orgScoped` to `tenantWhere`, which no longer treats an org-less session as unscoped. New e2e: `e2e/tenant-isolation-analytics-invites.spec.ts`.
